findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:229-231 + packages/main/src/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.ts:578-589 — HIGH: the story promises that the exact printed degraded command is executed through the worktree-local node bin/lattice.js entrypoint, but production guidance still prints global `lattice autopilot_review_submit` and the smoke only runs `zsh -n` syntax validation. In the self-host scenario that motivated this story, global lattice can resolve main old runtime without --deriveBindings, so all three printed commands are not proven executable and can deterministically fail while the test passes. Render the authoritative local entrypoint (or otherwise mechanically guarantee current runtime authority) and execute the exact three rendered commands in an isolated fixture, asserting three persisted complete-envelope verdicts and degraded-only 3x1 outcome.

packages/main/src/handlers/verdict.ts:121-130 — HIGH: --deriveBindings labels evidence current PASS and immediately turns it into gate-counting host-verdict bindings, but it only checks result/materialHash/storyFilesHash and optionally missingRequired. It does not enforce the existing routine-validation admissibility contract in phase-gates.ts:628-677: canonical lattice validate command, parseable allPass output, presence and current-input equality of verificationCoverage entries, blocking-dirty check, and head/material/storyFiles lineage freshness. The new smoke at review-escalation-smoke.ts:320-346 demonstrates the bypass by accepting synthetic evidence with command=review-escalation-smoke, output=pass (not JSON allPass), and total/required=1 with empty entries. Thus an evidence record TEST would rerun/reject can be promoted to complete canonical digests and counted by the review-assurance DONE gate. Extract/share a single validation-PASS admissibility helper with the TEST gate (or equivalently enforce every same invariant here), fail closed before persistence, and add adversarial tests for wrong command, non-allPass output, missing/stale coverage snapshot, missing freshness bindings, dirty worktree, and invalid head lineage.
